input: so yesterday i showed legato to my friend jörg in his office in stuttgart he immediately wanted to try the german model and read out a whole paragraph about the oktoberfest the recognition was almost perfect except for a few street names we talked for about forty minutes about on device models and he asked whether it also works on the u bahn without internet i said yes because everything runs locally on the phone he wants to test it next monday
reference: So yesterday I showed Legato to my friend Jörg in his office in Stuttgart. He immediately wanted to try the German model and read out a whole paragraph about the Oktoberfest. The recognition was almost perfect, except for a few street names. We talked for about 40 minutes about on-device models, and he asked whether it also works on the U-Bahn without internet. I said yes, because everything runs locally on the phone. He wants to test it next Monday.
